in_arabic.name: حائز
in_arabic.meaning: الحاصل على الشيء، المتمكن من الأمر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاعل من 'حاز'، ويعني الشخص الذي حصل على شيء، أو تمكن من أمر ما. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَحَازَ مَضَرَّتَهُ' (الآية 91 من سورة آل عمران). ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي يتميز بالقدرة على التحصيل والتمكن.

in_urdu.name: حائز
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو کسی چیز کا حصول کرے یا کسی امر پر قدرت حاصل کرے
in_urdu.long_meaning: حائز نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی چیز کو حاصل کرتا ہے یا کسی امر پر قدرت حاصل کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر کئی مقامات پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران کی آیت 91 میں: 'وَحَازَ مَضَرَّتَهُ'۔

in_hindi.name: हाज़
in_hindi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति किसी वस्तु को प्राप्त करता है या किसी कार्य को करने की क्षमता रखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हाज़ नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति किसी वस्तु को प्राप्त करता है या किसी कार्य को करने की क्षमता रखता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से निकला है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्वपूर्ण उपयोग होता है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में सक्षम होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: حایز
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کس چې کوم شی حاصلوي یا په يوه معامل باندې قدرت لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حایز نوم معنی دا ده چې هغه کس چې کوم شی حاصلوي یا په يوه معامل باندې قدرت لري. دا نوم د افغاني او پښتني کلتور کې مهم استعمال لري. په قرآن کريم کې د دې نوم يادونه په ډېرو ځايونو کې راغلی دی، لکه د سورت آل عمران په آيت 91 کې: 'وَحَازَ مَضَرَّتَهُ'.

in_english.name: Haaiz
in_english.meaning: One who acquires or obtains something
in_english.long_meaning: The name Haaiz originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-w-z,' which means to acquire, obtain, or gain. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person who possesses the ability to attain or achieve something. It is mentioned in several Quranic verses, including Surah Al Imran, verse 91: 'And he who takes on evil, has seized a loss.' The name Haaiz reflects qualities of capability, achievement, and determination.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haaiz carries a significant cultural impact as it denotes someone who plays the role of a guide or leader for others. In Islamic culture, it is an honor to be recognized as a Haaiz, as it reflects the virtue of compassion, empathy and care towards others. People often refer to a Haaiz as someone who is kind, knowledgeable and wise, making them a reliable source of advice and counsel. The power and responsibility of guidance are highly valued in Islamic teachings, and the name Haaiz serves to remind us of this essential character trait.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Haaiz holds immense significance as it is a reflection of the divine attribute of Mercy and Compassion. As Allah (SWT) is the ultimate Haaiz for all creation, guiding and supporting us through our trials and tribulations, bearing witness to our hardships and offering us solace and comfort. The name Haaiz thus serves as a constant reminder of Allah's (SWT) love and kindness towards us. It also encourages us to emulate this attribute in our relationships with others, thereby fostering a sense of compassion, empathy and caring towards all of God's creation.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Hakam, Futuh al-Buldan. This work describes the conquest of Egypt by the Arabs under the caliph 'Umar ibn al-Khattab in 640 AD. Haaiz is mentioned as a notable Egyptian Christian bishop who surrendered to 'Umar's forces.
historical_references.context: Conquest of Egypt by Arabs under Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi, Kitab al-Ittifak bi-Lughat al-Turk. This medieval Arabic work describes the early Islamic period in Egypt. Haaiz is mentioned as the bishop of Alexandria during the reign of Phocas (533-545 AD) and the role he played in the early Christian-Muslim relations.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic period in Egypt and Christian-Muslim relations
